text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even before the concert begins, cheers from the audience reach the girls waiting in the wings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This prompts Agnes Tachyon to declare that wishes have the potential to be explosive catalysts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the Grand Concert draws closer, the wishes of all those involved grow more resolute. It's time for our fourth concert!
